articles.title: Crypto market structure bill clears key hurdle as ethics debate looms over floor vote

articles.title: Crypto’s regulatory tailwind runs into a potential rates reset
Bitcoin is still stuck below its 200-day average. Treasury yields may be the reason.
articles.snippet: Rising yields may act as a headwind for assets like bitcoin and gold while potentially benefiting tokenized Treasury markets.

articles.title: Packs of Empty Waymos Are Weirding Out Atlanta Neighborhood
